options.B: The National Assembly has the power to remove the President
options.C: The judiciary has the power to make laws
options.D: The executive has the power to interpret laws

questions.stem: The concept of constitutionalism is closely related to the idea of the rule of law. Discuss the implications of this relationship on the protection of human rights in a democratic society.

options.A: The rule of law ensures that the government respects the rights of citizens, thereby protecting human rights.
options.B: Constitutionalism provides a framework for the protection of human rights, but the rule of law is not directly related to this protection.
options.C: The rule of law is a means of enforcing constitutional provisions, but it does not directly protect human rights.
options.D: The protection of human rights is not a concern of constitutionalism or the rule of law.

questions.stem: A political party's primary function is to win elections and hold power. Discuss the implications of this statement on the role of political parties in a democratic society.

options.A: Political parties play a crucial role in holding the government accountable to the people.
options.B: The primary function of a political party is to provide a platform for individuals to express their political views.
options.C: Political parties are responsible for promoting the interests of their members, rather than the general public.
options.D: The role of political parties in a democratic society is limited to providing a choice between different ideologies.

questions.stem: The concept of public administration is closely related to the idea of bureaucratic efficiency. Discuss the implications of this relationship on the delivery of public services.

options.A: Public administration is responsible for ensuring that public services are delivered in an efficient and effective manner.
options.B: The concept of bureaucratic efficiency is not directly related to the delivery of public services.
options.C: Public administration is responsible for promoting the interests of public officials, rather than the general public.
options.D: The delivery of public services is not a concern of public administration.

questions.stem: The concept of local government is closely related to the idea of decentralization. Discuss the implications of this relationship on the delivery of public services at the local level.

options.D: The delivery of public services at the local level is not a concern of local government.
